paragraphs: AM publishes digital primary source collections and sells the platform that makes them discoverable. The people it writes for are librarians and faculty who need students and researchers actually using the databases. Its materials are organised so that readers can browse by content series.

The other half of the business helps institutions build digital collection sites of their own. That platform is Quartex, and AM runs a support desk for it. Help is offered at every stage of a digital collections project rather than at delivery alone. The company also publishes news and commentary on primary sources, archives and libraries.

AM says libraries and archives around the world use its resources. It attends and organises events to stay close to that community. The footer identifies the business as Adam Matthew Digital Ltd, registered in England and Wales.
